11.t: Working with data: hunger and harvests
q: Which treatment gave the biggest harvest?
New seed + fertiliser (6.5 tonnes per hectare).
By how much did fertiliser increase the harvest of the old seed?
Calculate the percentage increase from old seed alone to new seed with fertiliser.
A politician says: "With this new seed nobody will go hungry." Evaluate this claim using the data and other factors.

The data shows science can more than double harvests. But farmers must afford the seed and fertiliser; weather, water, pests, war and how food is shared and sold also decide hunger. So it helps, but science alone will not end hunger.
